policy: Controlled clocks, identity bindings, storage faults and locks. Real published content/ChartPremiere fixture, production codecs/ownership adapter/import transaction. Not Creator production acceptance, physical-device authentication, full FileCarry or real external services.

C04 strict schema rejects FileCarry naming, unsupported versions, extra account facts and fake brand

C06 published narrative vector and referenced ChartRef tampering fail receiver revalidation
C07 internally recomputed media digest cannot substitute another published media reference
C08 published chart/visual replacement remains rejected after recomputing the internal content digest
C09 source HomeDevice alone may publish; receiver cannot impersonate sender
C10 unknown transfer and same-account self-asserted device header are not source authority
C11 exact publication binds transfer identity; legal same-Core change cannot replace or verify old transfer
C12 source proof rejects every changed identity and changed full-state digest
C13 two devices share one authority: source Homed, receiver CrossDeviceDuplicate, account isolation
C14 InitialWorld is excluded before authority queries and all ID factories
C15 unavailable authority and wrongly bound account/device never become a duplicate
C16 released/future ownership dispatch rejects copy; c never invents Migrated evidence
C17 no CopyPermission refuses as 档案损坏 before authority/UUID allocation and leaves input intact
C18 permission account mismatch or inconsistent FirstWorldCleared/CopyPermission is rejected
C19 independent remote adapter needs only receiver directory, never local source directory/lease/read
C20 new UUID and seven carrier rekeys preserve exact nonidentity values and original FormatTime
C21 source payload/sections are unchanged and account facts never become transfer or target fields
C22 actual inherited World session suppresses account clear writes and repeated premiere intents
C23 unfinished Complete source imports without manufacturing a completed account/world fact
C24 receiver target collision and tombstone reject before transaction/time factories
C25 strict request, directory identity and malformed UUID/transaction/time refuse preparation

S02 unprepared plan, missing import lock and missing true target lease never register or write
S03 absent Web Locks explicitly refuses without journal, authority registration or publication

S07 service success then HomeRegistered journal failure preserves Prepared for idempotent retry
S08 service target HomeConflict never overwrites winner or locally publishes, journal remains diagnostic
S09 Core write failure after service success retains HomeRegistered; retry writes target once successfully
S10 service success/local directory failure retains exact staged Core, never deletes it, recovery appends once
S11 adapter throws after atomic Core write: durable exact target remains recoverable
S12 adapter throws after atomic directory append: readback recognizes sole local publication point
S13 directory published but Published receipt write fails: deny open until reconciliation, never remove world
S14 adapter throws after atomic Published receipt: committed result remains Published
S15 all five durable write prefixes survive fresh storage process recovery with same target, registration and content
S16 Published world with currently unavailable authority cannot open; data remains for online retry
S17 local published/service missing denies opening; re-register same ID reconciles without deleting or republishing Core
S18 local published/service conflict never opens and reconciliation preserves published world
S19 corrupted/mismatched-device journals retain raw bytes and block reads/preparation/recovery
S20 unexpected staged Core mutation blocks retry without overwrite; source/account data remains
S21 published receipt allows legitimate later target revision, while immutable provenance and FormatTime guard opening
S22 tombstoned published target stays deleted; recovery cannot recreate it or erase retained Core
S23 pending/Published replay does not duplicate targets and conflicting transaction plans are rejected
S24 only one pending import per bound account; a different UUID/registration cannot bypass the journal
S25 account isolation refuses cross-account key reads or locks before touching any data

S27 Promise target-write callback cannot masquerade as durable synchronous publication
S28 missing or mismatched Published receipt never authorizes another local world
S29 another valid revision-zero Core cannot replace Published plan; genuine revision-one recalled state may progress
